captureEnvironment.checkout: Fresh clean clone of 3c86ede47de0ae181db0ce5e22c422078f6e8e44; git status was empty before capture and only the two output folders changed after it. The images were then copied byte for byte into the working tree.

reproducibility.repeatRun: After deleting the component-test cache again, a second desktop/high and mobile/low-static capture in the same clone reproduced all 72 scene images, 3 public previews and 6 capture records byte for byte.
reproducibility.independentRun: A separate verification clone with its own fresh cache produced the same 24 harvest-corner images and capture record byte for byte, and the same 6 capture records.
reproducibility.cacheDependence: The images depend on the component-test cache, not only on the commit. Scene.tsx (sky rim) and Environment.tsx (surface gradient and shade veil) each append a patch to three.js ShaderChunk.lights_fragment_end at module top level. The two patches do not commute: the gradient scales the indirect light that the rim adds to. Playwright keeps every component it has ever built in apps/garden/playwright/.cache. With the whole component-test suite registered (158 components), the bundler puts Scene.tsx in a chunk that the Environment.tsx chunk imports, so the sky rim is installed first and 0.44-3.25% of pixels per image differ (largest channel delta 45). With a fresh cache the surface gradient is installed first.
reproducibility.causeCheck: Swapping only the two install calls in the fresh bundle reproduced the earlier sky-rim-first harvest-corner desktop/high images and preview byte for byte (12 of 12), so the install order is the only difference.
reproducibility.appOrder: Plain ESM evaluation installs the surface gradient first for GameScene.tsx, GameSceneWrapper.tsx, the package entry index.ts, the outlet, kestenijada and pumpkin-trail viewers, and the capture fixture (checked from esbuild metafile import order). These images therefore follow the order the garden app is expected to use. This was not confirmed in a production Next.js build.
reproducibility.requirement: Until both patches are installed by one fixed-order function, run this capture only with an empty apps/garden/playwright/.cache. A capture from a cache that also holds other components is not reproducible evidence.
reproducibility.followUp: A fixed-order installer edits pinned renderer inputs (Scene.tsx, Environment.tsx), so it needs its own commit, a clean recapture and pin refresh. If it keeps the surface gradient first, the images should not change. It was not done here because the capture needs that change committed first.

supersededCapture.note: An earlier capture of the same commit on 2026-11-27 (09:34-09:38Z) was made in a working copy whose component-test cache held the whole suite, so the sky rim was installed first. A clean checkout with a fresh cache could not reproduce it. It was replaced before commit and is not part of this evidence. Its preview hashes are listed only for traceability.

visualReview.agentCheck: Agent check only, not an approval: all 72 scene images and 3 public previews were inspected beside the previous HEAD images in before/after contact sheets. Every included and scenery object is visible in every scene with the same placement, framing and camera, and no frame is black or blank (decoded mean luma 115.6-205.7, no near-black pixels). In all six capture records the object identities, roles, mesh counts, layout, included/scenery lists, dates and camera/viewport settings are unchanged. Projected bounds of included pieces moved by at most 8 px (EnamelGardenLamp; 5.5 px StoneMedium, 5 px FallenLog, under 4 px for the rest); the scenery Tree and Pine moved by up to 51.5 px because their re-exported crowns are a different size. The only new record field is autumn.springFreshness, which was absent before and is now 0.
notesForReviewer: Sky, lighting and palette follow the party-toy style: blue day sky, lavender overcast clouds, pink dusk and a light lavender night with green grass, instead of the earlier cream, olive and dark navy looks.
The walkway is now lavender and tan, the stone is lavender, and the late-autumn tree keeps a small orange crown instead of bare branches.
At dusk and night the evening-seat lamp glow is much weaker than in the original review, because the night garden is lit. docs/autumn-arrangements-2026.md still describes the original review.

These images install the surface gradient before the sky rim (see reproducibility). Shaded side faces are slightly greener and darker than in the sky-rim-first render that a local component-test build holding the whole suite produced.
